review.meaning: synthetic tests pass and every rule was checked against the printed label and the live Monday labels; not approved by RSFA, not compared with a MacroForge output
openQuestions: Live Monday labels with no rule (label drift since the legacy configuration): '$150,001-$250,000' and 'Occasionally (monthly / quarterly)' (cash deposits and international payments). The engine refuses these values (UNMAPPED_OPTION) until RSFA decides whether to update the rules; MacroForge would leave the boxes blank.
'What do you intend to use your accounts for?' is multi-select on Monday; the legacy equals rules represent one label only, so two labels are refused (MULTI_SELECT_NOT_REPRESENTABLE).
